title: Fourth special sitting of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/2025/20/ޚޞ/4).

From the Speaker's desk: the President has returned, for reconsideration under Article 91(a) of the Constitution, the First Amendment Bill to the Thalassaemia Control Act (Law No. 4/2012), which Parliament had passed and sent for ratification.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Maldives Media and Broadcasting Regulation Bill submitted by Thulhaadhoo MP Abdul Hannan Aboobakuru.

Report of the Human Rights and Gender Committee on the President's nomination of a member to the Human Rights Commission under Article 190(b) of the Constitution and Article 5 of the Human Rights Commission Act (Law No. 6/2006).

Report of the Independent Institutions Committee on the President's nomination of three members to the Civil Service Commission under Article 180(b) of the Constitution and Article 13 of the Civil Service Act (Law No. 5/2007).

Report of the Economic Committee on the President's nomination of four members to the board of the Maldives Inland Revenue Authority under Article 4(b)(2) of the Tax Administration Act (Law No. 3/2010).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: This special sitting received the President's veto of the Thalassaemia Act amendment, continued debating the Media and Broadcasting Regulation Bill, and took up committee reports on nominees to the Human Rights Commission, Civil Service Commission and MIRA board.
